_about: GitHub issue #2 (white boxes after loading), part 2 of 2: run with Send-Suite -Fresh, after decal-reload-save.json. Loads the saved city in a game that has never made the 'Placemaker Decal' copies the save names (what a player meets after restarting the game): first with the clean-up after loads switched off (the white boxes of older builds), then again with it on (they are removed). The camera looks at the spot part 1 recorded ('atAbs' of its oldDecal steps); the save is deleted at the end.
